visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium close-up of a mother and her two daughters lying in bed, leaning against a tufted headboard. They are wearing matching light blue and white pajamas with cartoon character prints. Several plush toys, including yellow and purple rabbits, are lined up behind them. The lighting is soft and warm. (2) The scene shifts to an elevator where a family of four is taking a mirror selfie. The father holds a smartphone, wearing a green t-shirt; the mother is in a white shirt and pink pants; and two daughters stand in front of them, one in a pink outfit and the younger in a green dress. The elevator interior has functional signage and a security camera visible on the ceiling. (3) A series of rapid montages follow, showing the father and elder daughter outside a 'CUMAR' retail store at night with bright city lights. Then, the mother and elder daughter pose by a riverside with a bridge in the background. The daughter wears a pink crop top and denim skirt, with a digital toy attached to her belt. (4) The elder daughter is seen unboxing multiple 'NewJeans' music albums on a table with a black marble backsplash. She appears excited with a wide-mouthed expression. Subsequent shots show her playing with a small white fluffy dog indoors, and feeding her younger sister popcorn under an outdoor umbrella. (5) On an airplane, the two daughters pose for the camera near a window; the elder girl winks while the younger one makes a peace sign. They are then seen at a hot air balloon festival with a large crowd in the background and colorful balloons inflating. (6) Further clips show the elder daughter in a professional recording studio wearing large headphones and singing into a microphone, sitting on a rooftop with a blue track background, and the whole family posing in front of European-style brick buildings and city bridges at sunset. (7) Towards the end, the girls take a selfie overlooking a sprawling cityscape, grill meat at a restaurant, and celebrate in a living room with Christmas decorations and stacked cardboard boxes. The final shot is a vibrant, hand-drawn animation of the family of four standing on a wooden walkway in a mountainous landscape.
